title: Messy CSV/TSV Data Cleaner & Deduplicator
target_pain: Engineers and data analysts waste hours manually cleaning malformed CSV/TSV files, fixing mismatched columns, trimming whitespace, removing duplicate rows, and escaping special HTML entities.
key_features: Instant browser-side parsing & robust delimiter auto-detection
Advanced duplicate removal by primary key or exact row matching
Smart whitespace trimmer & HTML entity decoder (e.g. ' to ')
Real-time data preview with live error detection and row/column stats
Export cleaned results instantly to CSV or JSON format
